  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Plan Gate and Scope-Change Protocol</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">Part A: the written plan-gate policy, filled once, signed and pinned. Output: a policy with a named approval authority and a hard scope-change rule.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-CS-APM-plan-gate</b><br>
      Pack Z &middot; fill order 17<br>
      type <b>decision</b><br>
      audience <b>eng-leader</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>The APM Auth + Logging Overhaul</b> &middot; Eight Plan Iterations &middot;
    <code>case-study-apm-overhaul.qmd</code> L73-97 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/case-study-apm-overhaul.html#sec-cs-apm-plan-iterations">#sec-cs-apm-plan-iterations</a><br>
    Prerequisite: <b>WS-17-escalation-autonomy-ladder</b> (supplies the L1-L4 holders used by A5 and B5).
    Feeds <b>WS-18-wave-decomposition-plan</b>: only an approved plan gets waved.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Fill this in the room, with the person who will actually be interrupted present. Name two
    individuals who can approve a plan version, say what evidence you will accept for a scope
    expansion, and say where mid-wave discoveries go. Row A4 is not yours to reword: read it aloud,
    then countersign it. Write in pen.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Part A &mdash; Policy <span class="ws-block-note">filled once per organization</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:5%"><col style="width:19%"><col style="width:32%"><col style="width:44%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th></th><th>Field</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">1</span></td>
          <td><b>Plan gate approval authority</b><br><small>A1 &middot; the individual who approves a plan version</small></td>
          <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">derived from cs-apm L85 "Approved"</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">2</span></td>
          <td><b>Deputy when A1 is unavailable</b><br><small>A2 &middot; a gate with one name is a gate that closes on holiday</small></td>
          <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">org</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">3</span></td>
          <td><b>Evidence required for a scope expansion</b><br><small>A3 &middot; the evidence classes this org will accept</small></td>
          <td class="prior">Worked instances: expert panel findings (v3), architecture expert review (v4), an audit by dispatched explore agents (v7)<span class="prior-src">cs-apm L80-81, L89-90</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">4</span></td>
          <td><b>The hard rule</b><br><small>A4 &middot; countersign only; not editable</small></td>
          <td class="prior">"The scope expanded <i>before</i> execution began, through the plan gate, not mid-wave."<span class="prior-src">cs-apm L92-93</span></td>
          <td class="fill tall"><span class="f-sign"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">5</span></td>
          <td><b>What happens when scope changes are discovered mid-wave</b><br><small>A5 &middot; who receives it, and where it waits</small></td>
          <td class="prior">The ladder's L4 response: a follow-up task, raised for the next gate<span class="prior-src">ch17 L349 via WS-17-escalation-autonomy-ladder</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">6</span></td>
          <td><b>In-plan file classes</b><br><small>A6 &middot; which classes count as planned scope</small></td>
          <td class="prior">Primary source files (the case planned 47)<span class="prior-src">cs-apm L95</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">7</span></td>
          <td><b>Incidental file classes &mdash; discovery does not re-open the gate</b><br><small>A7 &middot; anything not listed here re-opens the gate</small></td>
          <td class="prior">Test files, configuration updates, documentation changes (the case's additional 28)<span class="prior-src">cs-apm L95</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">8</span></td>
          <td><b>Policy sponsor signature + date</b><br><small>A8 &middot; the engineering leader who owns delivery</small></td>
          <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">org</span></td>
          <td class="fill tall"><span class="f-sign"></span>
            <div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div></td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Plan Gate and Scope-Change Protocol &mdash; Part B</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">The iteration log: one row per plan version, filled once per initiative. Reusable template.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-CS-APM-plan-gate</b><br>
      Pack Z &middot; fill order 17<br>
      type <b>decision</b><br>
      audience <b>eng-leader</b>

  <div class="ws-source">

  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Keep this log as a live file in the pilot repository (a spreadsheet or a markdown table under
    version control), not on paper: it gains rows over weeks. This page is the template to copy its
    columns from. Every row needs a trigger and a named raiser. A tick in B8 means the hard rule (A4)
    has been breached and the change routes to A5 instead.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Part B &mdash; Version log <span class="ws-block-note">one row per version; B4 may be extended with triggers the case did not meet</span></h2>

      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>

          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">L1</span><span class="opt">L2</span><span class="opt">L3</span><span class="opt">L4</span><span class="opt">none</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-checkline"><span class="f-check"></span>yes</span></td>

          <td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>

          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">initial triage</span><span class="opt">user correction</span><span class="opt">expert panel findings</span><span class="opt">architecture expert</span><span class="opt">orchestrator restructure</span><span class="opt">instrumented-codebase need</span><span class="opt">user escalation</span><span class="opt">approved</span></div><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">L1</span><span class="opt">L2</span><span class="opt">L3</span><span class="opt">L4</span><span class="opt">none</span></div></td>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>B5 definitions <span class="ws-block-note">the escalation ladder, ch17 L344-349; the case's v7 is an L4</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup><col style="width:14%"><col style="width:30%"><col style="width:28%"><col style="width:28%"></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th>Level</th><th>Trigger</th><th>Response</th><th>Example</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td class="prior">L1: Self-heal</td><td class="prior">Agent hits a test failure it can debug</td><td class="prior">Agent fixes and continues</td><td class="prior">Type error in generated code</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="prior">L2: Retry</td><td class="prior">Agent produces incomplete output</td><td class="prior">Re-dispatch with refined prompt</td><td class="prior">Agent missed 3 of 12 files in scope</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="prior">L3: Human decides</td><td class="prior">Trade-off between competing principles</td><td class="prior">Human makes design call</td><td class="prior">UX convention vs. architectural purity</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="prior">L4: Scope change</td><td class="prior">Finding requires work outside the current plan</td><td class="prior">Human creates follow-up task</td><td class="prior">Discovery of a pre-existing bug unrelated to the change</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
